To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we report on the first ambient-stable single crystal n-channel organic transistors with the highest mobility of 8.6cm(2) V-1s(-1) in the air.
we developed a new method to produce single-crystal transistors based upon microribbon-shaped organic single crystals.

we have developed a novel naphthalene‐diimide derivative with a chlorine substituent in the central ring, which is a promising candidate for n‐channel organic single crystal field‐effect transistors with excellent ambient stability and high performance.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design, synthesis and application of new organic semiconductors.
the synthesis and characterization of a new series of naphthalene-diimide derivatives, the core chlorinated NDI derivatives.
the synthesis and properties of a novel n-type organic single crystal field-effect transistor (SCFET) based on core-chlorinated naphthalene-diimide.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the use of the core chlorinated naphthalene dimide Cl2- NDI as a semiconducting material in the fabrication of organic single crystal field effect transistors (SCFETs) has resulted in devices with excellent performance and ambient stability, with a mobility of 8.6cm(2) V-1 s-1 and a current on/off ratio of 10(6), and that this material can be used in the construction of complementary circuits.
we have demonstrated a new approach to the fabrication of high performance single crystal transistorms based on core-chlorinated naphthalene dimide (Cl2-NDI) microribbons.

the combination of ambient stability, high mobility, and the ability to fabricate devices with a wide range of geometries and channel lengths, makes the naphthalene core chlorinated naphthalene-diimide (Cl2-NDI) an excellent candidate for future organic electronics applications.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed a new class of air-stable n-channel organic single crystal field-effect transistors based microribbons of core-chlorinated naphthalene-diimide (Cl2-NDI).
we have developed the first air-stable n-channel organic single crystal field-effect transistors (SCFETs) based on microribbons of core-chlorinated Naphtha­lene Diimide (Cl2-NDI).
we have demonstrated the first air-stable n-channel organic single crystal field effect transistors based microribbons of core-chlorinated naphthalene dimide (Cl2-NDI).
The main takeaway from our work is that
it is possible to make n-channel organic SCFETs that are stable in air.
the naphthalene core is a viable alternative to the benzene ring as the backbone for high mobility n-type semiconductors.
the combination of a core-chlorinated NDI with the ribbon-shaped morphology results in the formation of a highly ordered and crystalline organic semiconductor that is stable in air.
